capabilities: increase or decrease sidebar widths by a set increment
toggle sidebars between standard and zero width
expand or collapse both sidebars at once
distribute left and right sidebar widths to specified percentages
configure width increment and standard widths in settings
extras: No hotkeys are bound by default; the README only suggests example keybindings users can set themselves.
problem: Obsidian gives no built-in commands or settings to precisely control or resize the sidebar widths.
summary: Command-based sidebar resizer that adjusts left and right sidebar widths in pixels or percentages via commands and hotkeys.
